name: @domio/viewer-identity
description: Phase 17 W3 — Viewer identity graph + 4 privacy modes + GDPR endpoints. Stores salted viewer_id_key hashes in Postgres; merges cross-device identities via last-seen IP/UA + opt-in email hash; serves DELETE/export/object endpoints for GDPR right-to-erasure / right-to-access / right-to-object.
